history.summary: A 2014 99-yr leasehold 4BR EC-style condo in Sengkang (D19), 1,227 sqft at $1.85M / $1,508 psf, near Kangkar LRT. Sub-$2M and in the deep-liquidity band, but it's an LRT-only (no MRT) location, a 4BR niche unit and lacks project-specific URA data — a fair OCR hold, not a growth play.
history.rating_rationale: $1,508 psf for a 12-year-old 99-yr LH 4BR in Sengkang is market-typical. Connectivity is LRT-only (Kangkar LRT 750m, needs feeder to Sengkang MRT). No project URA series; score_1000 539, even-ish 243-172 record. D19/PDD/CRL gives a regional tailwind but this specific stack has no standout catalyst.
red_flags: LRT-only access (Kangkar LRT) — no direct MRT, weaker connectivity premium
No project-specific URA appreciation data — regional-baseline fallback
2014 build — mid-life leasehold with ~88 years remaining
catalysts: D19 Punggol Digital District + Cross Island Line regional uplift
Sub-$2M 4BR entry in the deep-liquidity band for HDB upgraders
Large family-format unit with EC-style spacious layout

history.summary: Large 1,475 sqft 3BR in a 2014 Sengkang EC (Executive Condo) at $1,180 psf. The algo's -30.5% age-adj 'very cheap' read is mostly an EC-vs-private structural discount, not a true bargain — but $1,180 psf for a big fully-privatising EC family unit in a strong OCR region is fair value.
history.rating_rationale: Critical correction the algo missed: Austville is an EXECUTIVE CONDOMINIUM, which structurally trades 20-30% below private condos, so the -30.5% age-adj premium and 'very_low_psf' flag are largely the EC discount, not alpha. Web check: trailing-12m resales $1,033-1,468 psf, avg ~$1,354, with a Dec-2025 1,227 sqft at $1,345 psf. At $1,180 psf this listing is at the LOW end of its own project's range — modestly cheap for the project, decent for a large 1,475 sqft unit, but the asking total $1.74m is rich for a Sengkang EC 3BR. appreciation_txns=0 (regional baseline, no forward signal). D19 is a top forward region (OCR ~+4%). It's a fair, liveable family unit with no glaring overpay, but no decisive edge — Neutral.
red_flags: It's an EC — the 'very_low_psf' flag overstates cheapness vs private comps
Appreciation derived from regional baseline (0 project transactions in the signal)
$1.74m asking is at the upper bound of recent Austville total prices
catalysts: Fully privatised EC (post-10yr) — open to all buyers and foreigners on resale
D19/Sengkang is a leading OCR forward-appreciation region per v3.4 backtest
Large 1,475 sqft layout suits the family-upgrader resale market
